requested_outcome: Persist Biz aggregate bookings and revenue after an admin pull so reloads reuse saved data instead of recalculating every business.
natural_destination: The authenticated VII business-performance administration report.
authorization_boundary: Implement and verify in the current candidate. Production publication still requires an explicit deploy instruction and verified production route.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request changes authoritative operational behavior in the administration system.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require durable server-side persistence, reload proof, freshness visibility and role preservation.

lesson_bundle.reason: A cache success claim is incomplete without repeat-request and failure-state evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Test first pull, second pull, reload, forced refresh and stale fallback.

lesson_bundle.reason: The change affects production reporting and must not be called live without exact-release evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Keep candidate and public status separate and require a verified deploy route.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The dashboard remembers data only in the current browser tab and loses it after reload.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Store aggregate snapshots in the runtime database and return them with the report query.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A new request using the same database returns the saved snapshot.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A repeated pull still calls Biz for every business.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Key fresh snapshots by world, supplier business and exact date range.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The second identical pull completes with zero extra supplier calls.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A temporary Biz failure deletes or hides previously loaded totals.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use stale-if-error and never overwrite the last good payload on failure.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A forced refresh failure returns the saved value with stale_fallback status.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Detailed phone records are retained merely to accelerate aggregate reporting.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Strip contacts before persistence and cache only summary and click aggregates.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The persisted payload contains no contacts field.

affected_family: Business-performance report reload and date-range changes.
Biz aggregate batch pulls for vacations, events and hourly rooms.
Explicit refresh and supplier-unavailable recovery states.

sources.label: VII platform data and cache policy

midpoint_gate.trigger: The isolated persistent-cache slice is implemented.
checks: Prove first pull persists and the second identical pull makes no supplier call.
Prove detailed contacts are absent from the stored aggregate.

attack_questions: Does a page reload still show the saved exact-range totals?
Can a supplier outage erase the last good snapshot?
Can two businesses or two date ranges collide in one cache key?
Are phone-level contact details accidentally persisted?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Open the authenticated business-performance report, load a range, reload it and inspect saved-time status.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Run cache isolation, admin report and conversion adapter regression tests plus the production build.

effectiveness.baseline: Every batch reload called Biz again for every selected supported business.
measurements: supplier calls on first identical request
supplier calls on second identical request
effectiveness.target: One supplier call on the first pull, zero on a fresh identical pull, and no loss of the last good aggregate during failure.
